description: This file defines a helper class 'file' with static methods for handling file operations such as MIME type detection, extension extraction, writability check, and generating unique filenames within the KCFinder project.

classes.name: file
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for file operations such as MIME type detection, extension extraction, writability check, and filename generation.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the given file is writable, working around Windows server limitations.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename, optionally converting to lowercase.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file, using PHP's finfo extension if available, otherwise based on file extension.

methods.name: getInexistantFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename that does not exist by appending a suffix if necessary, based on a template.
